new.text: 8.4.2 IdsM_TpTxConfirmation [SWS_IdsM_91011] Definition of callback function IdsM_TpTxConfirmation ⌈ Service Name IdsM_TpTxConfirmation Syntax void IdsM_TpTxConfirmation ( PduIdType id, Std_ReturnType result ) Service ID [hex] 0x48 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant id Identification of the transmitted I-PDU. Parameters (in) result E_OK: The PDU was transmitted. E_NOT_OK: Transmission of the PDU failed. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description The function is called to confirm a successful transmission of the TP IdsM-UpperLayerTxPdu or to report an error that occurred during transmission. Available via IdsM_PduR.h ⌋
